ruleDefinitions.name: Detected Windows Software Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*query.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*svcversion.*")))
